Hi Alicia —

Great to meet earlier today. Thanks for the time — I've attached the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and an evaluation plan summarizing the scope, success criteria, and suggested owners/dates based on our discussion.

Could you please confirm:
- Owners for evaluation (technical owner + procurement / legal point of contact)
- Target dates for the 2-week evaluation and internal checkpoints
- Any constraints (security reviews, procurement windows) that would affect timing

I've proposed dates in the MAP (Evaluation start: 2027-05-23, Checkpoint 1: 2027-05-30). If those don't work, let me know preferred alternatives.

Next steps:
1) You confirm owners & dates
2) We enable a dedicated eval environment and share test prompts/metrics
3) Marissa (CS) will set up onboarding session

Thanks — I'll hold open the slots on 5/23 and 5/30 for now.
